problem: tds3 compared wall-clock return time with the next PCM presentation deadline, inserting whole silent blocks and dropping subsequent data despite no RTP loss.
fix: Sample-counted output cursor; preserve continuous PCM through small clock corrections; re-anchor on FLUSH or timing discontinuities beyond 20 ms.

regression.model: 352-sample PCM writes split into 251-sample UDP packets, last-complete-packet return time, 3 ms scheduling variation and 2 ms sync corrections
additional_checks: FLUSH clears queued data and resumes

limitations: 20 ms tolerance is partial synchronization, not sample-rate resampling.
Previous pause tail was reported much improved; its exact cause is not established.
